assertion_analysis.assertions: remaining == []; ledger run-id set equals fixture run-id set; promoted_by == review-self; gate == not-run
assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Removing the added scope-report ready branch leaves code/portfolio pointers and omits ledger rows; changing promotion attribution or gate verdict breaks the corresponding independent ledger read. The recorded base negative control fails both pass-count variants.

assertion_analysis.assertions: all pointers remain; ledger empty; all refusal reasons name reservation
assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Removing manual_landing_reason promotes valid reports, deletes pointers and writes rows. Wrong reason text fails for emitted entries; the reason-only all() is vacuous on an empty refusal list, but pointer and ledger checks independently assert the hold.

assertion_analysis.assertions: not promoted; reason contains report; pointer survives
assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Bypassing report parsing admits the deliberately unstructured report and changes promotion/pointer observations; an unrelated refusal may satisfy the broad report substring, so this is weaker than checking a precise refusal.

assertion_analysis.assertions: self_promoted contains the plan fixture; exactly one row; attribution and gate values
assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Breaking the existing plan delivery join omits self_promoted and its ledger row; changing those stored fields breaks the field assertions.

assertion_analysis.assertions: not promoted; expected refusal substring; pointer survives for stale/wrong-project/undeclared cases
assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Removing each freshness, project identity or declaration condition makes its adversarial input eligible and deletes its pointer; replacing the expected refusal with another reason fails the substring check. The wrong-subject case actually mutates project, not subject.

assertion_analysis.assertions: review self-promotion returns None for implementation; refusal exists and is unaccepted; integrated verdict failed; independent failing-test id retained; pointer survives; ledger empty
assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Applying the report bypass to implementation runs or ignoring the real assert-False merged-head gate violates rejection, pointer or ledger assertions; dropping or changing the gate test id violates the literal expected id read from the gate report.

assertion_independence: No added assertion simply compares an echoed input value with itself: run-id expectations are checked against independent pointer/ledger effects; refusal substrings are checked against generated refusals. Storage success itself is unasserted.

findings.text: blocking: the sidecar validation checks project and scope key but not subject; with subject missing or mistyped and an otherwise valid fresh report, the selected parser supplies the expected body subject and readiness succeeds, while delivered_code_reviews and delivered_portfolio_reviews filter that sidecar out, so promotion_checks.py:3016 and :3022 store nothing and promotion can remove the pointer with an outcome claiming the review was stored; validate the same subject the storage owner requires and assert the persisted record in the regression test.
